briefs.text: Trump blames Democrats for a $1tn Wall Street sell-off after midterms.
Haiti's forces kill 34 gang members in offensive to retake Martissant.
Verstappen wins the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
Iran's IRGC claims it shot down 78 advanced American drones.
China sets 2030 targets for elderly care and childcare support.
South Korea's president nominates new foreign minister, intel chief.
India, Nepal flag off Saryu-Kamala Express: Ayodhya to Janakpur Dham.
Modi announces Rs 15,000 crore package; India, Nepal sign 8 MoUs.
India's oil and gas import bill jumped by around 60% in October.
Pilots urge Delhi to act over SpiceJet's unpaid salaries and debts.
Lahore is the world's most polluted city; air index crosses 500.
Bangladesh begins mass typhoid vaccination vs drug-resistant strains.
Bangladesh vows to arrest ex-PM Sheikh Hasina if she returns.
Ukraine's sea drones strike a Russian warship off Libya.
Analysis: more than 700,000 Russian soldiers have died in Ukraine.
Gisèle Pelicot 'deeply shocked' as nude images promote a book.
Ferrari unveils the 296 Challenge Stradale and 296 Challenge Evo in Spain.
Armenia proposes a new constitution to advance peace talks with Azerbaijan.
CAS rules Tuesday on Senegal's appeal over stripped AFCON title.
Seventh round of Swiss talks on Sudan's war opens Wed in Nyon.
Johannesburg's mayor vote is pushed to Friday as coalition talks drag on.
Nigeria endorses a $350m programme to prepare for floods, droughts and fires.
Ivory Coast's cocoa buyout cost $448m, its cacao council accounts.
UN Libya mission urges independent probe into Benghazi attacks.
Pope Leo XIV begins 12-day S. America tour after lung cancer surgery.
De la Espriella claims victory in Colombia's runoff, early count.
Argentina's country risk jumps 10% to top 1,000 points amid a bond sell-off.
Brazil forecasters lift their end-2027 Selic rate outlook to 13.00%.
Humpback calves vanish; Queensland sightings down 90% on 2025.
China's Xuelong sails from Australia for Zhongshan Station.

dateline: TUESDAY, 24 NOVEMBER 2026 · 37 STORIES FROM 8 CONTINENTS · THE WORLD IN ONE PAGE

features.body: Delegates head home with no fossil-fuel deal. Analysts ask what the collapse reveals about a divided world.
features.headline: COP31: THE MORNING AFTER

features.body: A ferry carrying 133 people capsizes off the coast of Guyana on Saturday night; dozens are feared to have died.
features.headline: FERRY SINKS: DOZENS FEARED DEAD

features.body: A Don Toliver concert in Manchester is evacuated after an 'unknown substance' is reported inside the venue.
features.headline: CONCERT EVACUATED

features.body: India and New Zealand draw the 1st Test in Wellington; Pant's 128 is the highlight, and India's WTC final hopes are dented.
features.headline: TEST ENDS LEVEL

hero.body: The blaze tore through the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia confectionery plant on Saturday evening, with some 300 people on shift. A presidential adviser confirms 24 dead; an air-conditioner short circuit is the suspected cause, and DNA tests to identify the dead could take two to three weeks.
hero.deck: Rescuers search the unstable wreckage of a Banten candy factory for about 30 workers still missing.

second.body: The Dow leaps about 1,500 points (+3.1%) and the Nasdaq surges over 6% — its best day since April last year — as Jensen Huang returns to lead Nvidia. The S&P 500 climbs about 5%, clawing back part of last week's rout, the worst since March 2020.
second.headline: WALL STREET ROARS BACK

second.body: Ursula von der Leyen proposes a 22nd sanctions package: some 60 banks cut from SWIFT, a crackdown on crypto platforms, 70 more shadow-fleet ships listed, and a ban on Russians competing under their flag in European sport.
second.headline: EU AIMS AT RUSSIA'S BANKS

title: THE TUESDAY MERIDIAN
